description: Welcome to Orbix Nova! 🚀 We are building an interactive Space Mission Design Game that brings spacecraft engineering, orbital mechanics, and resource management to life—powered by AI-assisted development.
summary: CosmosLens: Evolution of Space Telescopes is an interactive 2D educational space engineering and exploration game where players take on the role of a NASA aerospace engineer and astronomer. Starting in a ground laboratory, players design, build, and launch custom space telescopes while balancing real-world engineering trade-offs like payload mass, power budgets, and optical precision.Key Gameplay Loop:Engineering Workshop: Assemble core subsystems (optics, spectral sensors, and shielding) within a fixed budget to meet strict mass and power limits.Launch & Atmospheric Challenges: Navigate Earth’s turbulent atmosphere and pollution layers, receiving real-time telemetry alerts that explain the scientific causes behind any assembly flaws.Lab Data Correction: Capture raw, blurry orbital images (simulating historical challenges like Hubble’s spherical aberration) and return them to the lab to sharpen and analyze light and gas data ($NO_2$, $CO_2$).Historical Progression: High-clarity discoveries earn NASA research grants ($), unlocking iconic historical eras (Hubble, Spitzer, James Webb), deeper cosmic targets, and an interactive NASA Science Card gallery.
details: CosmosLens: Evolution of Space Telescopes is an interactive educational web game where players act as NASA aerospace engineers and astronomers. Starting in a lab, players custom-build telescopes while managing mass, power, and budget limits. After launching through Earth's atmosphere, they capture raw, blurry orbital images and bring them back to the lab to clean and analyze light and atmospheric gas data ($NO_2$, $CO_2$). Successful discoveries earn research grants to unlock advanced historical eras—from Hubble to modern observatories—combining STEM education with hands-on space exploration.
